title: Reviewer Output
description: Output contract for the `reviewer` agent. Code review with severity-rated findings plus an external GPT-5.4 review pass.

overall_severity.description: Highest severity across all findings. 'pass' means no findings.

findings.description: Numbered findings, each with severity and remediation.

evidence.description: Command output or specific excerpt proving the issue (NOT just reasoning). Optional but strongly recommended.

submitted.description: Whether the changed files were submitted to GPT-5.4 for review.

submission_skip_reason.description: If submitted is false, why (e.g., 'llm CLI not available'). Required when submitted is false.

verdict.description: GPT-5.4's final verdict. 'n/a' if not submitted.

notable_findings.description: Findings from GPT-5.4 that this reviewer agrees with and has incorporated into `findings` above.

dismissed_findings.description: Findings from GPT-5.4 evaluated and dismissed as false positives, with reason.

missing_test_coverage.description: Specific scenarios that should be tested but aren't.

conditions.description: Required only when verdict is 'conditional'. Each item is a precondition for approval.

analysis_scratchpad.description: Optional. The reviewer's pre-output reasoning. Useful for auditing but not validated for content.
